title: 第1154章 又救你一次第1153章 地球有剑
content_zh:
“姐姐，这个真的可以唤醒老爷吗？
紫皮大蛙手中端着莲台老头依旧端坐其上双目紧闭
而在其额头之上此刻正敷着一片碧蓝树叶只见其上散发着淡淡灵光在其作用下老人的面容明显舒畅了许多
“不知道，希望可以吧”
面对扎娜的疑问清梦仙子只能摇头
这片神奇的苏叶便是敖雪交给他的，此物乃是一道专注于神魂修复一道上的灵物，名为清心神叶
哪怕是走火入魔的人也能在前期将之救回
然而敷在杨威的头上已经过了好一阵，不管清梦仙子如何催发最多也就杨威的神色好些不见其有醒转的征兆
而且祸不单行，又有几道遁光落在了两女身前
他们皆是早已在此等待的秦国修士
为首一人身穿一袭碧绿长袍面上五缕长须随风飘扬，他的身形干瘦手中握着一节碧绿竹杆，周身散发着一股儒雅气息
此人的身份可不简单乃是秦国二十四神将之一，并且还是排名第四的神将天兵营枯竹神将儒法玉
在其身后跟随着一众手握竹柄长刀的战修，他们皆是披着青竹板甲一个个目光不善的望着杨威，仿佛这就是送上门的战功一般
“呵呵，没想到真就让我等伏击到了”
不等清梦仙子向后逃遁，又有一个个如土拨鼠般的人影从地底钻出
为首一人身形矮小是个侏儒，却没人敢小看他，因为他也是二十四神将之一并且是仅次于枯竹神将排名在第五的地煞营，金鼠神将，白焱
在他身后的战修们皆是穿得如同穿山甲一般，覆着特殊油光滑亮的铠甲所使用的法宝也都是爪子
“投降吧，你们已经无处可逃了”
枯竹神将抚须悠悠道
“不许你们伤害老爷”

却是扎娜起身张开双臂拦在了杨威身前
“你？如何保护他？
金鼠神将不由冷笑，他只要稍稍释放出自身灵压就能将眼前女子压得只能匍匐在地
然而扎娜并没有如他所想的那般崩溃，反而更加坚定的挡在杨威身前，纵使自身伤痕累累也绝不后退
“这次换我保护你”
元婴后期的灵压岂是筑基可以抗衡的，扎娜浑身颤抖着却也绝不回头
今日纵使要死她也要抵抗到最后一刻，是身后男人让她看到了希望，知晓了这个世界上还有美好，外面的景色又是如何迷人
所以她不能后退，为了杨威她能做的并不多，却愿意用生命为这段于她而言轰轰烈烈的短暂相遇画上句号
“好，既然你求死，那本座便成全你”
金鼠神将见此女不怕吓唬也不再多言，左右便是一爪下去结果了性命
“等等”
清梦欲要阻拦而枯竹神将早已上前一步，挡在了他的身前手中青竹轻轻朝气一点
“砰！
下一刻一道磅礴的冲击力便将清梦狠狠的砸飞了出去顿时鲜血迸飞
“主人！
content_en:
"Sister, can this really wake up the master?
The big purple-skinned frog holds the lotus in his hand and the old man is still sitting on it with his eyes closed.
At this moment, a piece of blue leaf was placed on his forehead, and there was a faint spiritual light emitting from it. Under its influence, the old man's face was obviously much more relaxed.
"I don't know, I hope so."
Faced with Zana's question, Fairy Qingmeng could only shake her head.
This magical Su Ye was given to him by Ao Xue. This object is a spiritual object that focuses on the restoration of the soul. It is called the Qingxin Shen Ye.
Even those who have gone crazy can be rescued early on.
However, it had been a long time since it was applied on Yang Wei's head. No matter how Qingmeng Fairy tried to stimulate it, at most Yang Wei's expression looked better and there was no sign of him waking up.
And misfortunes never come singly, as several rays of light fell in front of the two women.
They are all Qin monks who have been waiting here for a long time
The leader was wearing a green robe, with five long strands of beard fluttering in the wind. His thin figure held a green bamboo pole in his hand, and he exuded an elegant atmosphere.
This person's identity is not simple. He is one of the twenty-four divine generals of the Qin Kingdom, and he is also the fourth ranked divine general.
Behind him were a group of warrior cultivators holding long swords with bamboo handles. They were all wearing green bamboo plate armor and looked at Yang Wei with unkind eyes, as if this was the war achievement delivered to his door.
"Haha, I didn't expect that they would make me wait for the ambush."
Before Fairy Qingmeng could escape, another figure like a groundhog emerged from the ground.
The first person is short and a dwarf, but no one dares to underestimate him, because he is also one of the twenty-four divine generals and is ranked fifth after the Withered Bamboo Divine General in the Disha Camp, the Golden Rat Divine General, and Bai Yan.
The war cultivators behind him were all dressed like pangolins, covered with special oily and shiny armor, and the magic weapons they used were also claws.
"Surrender, you have nowhere to escape."
The God of Dry Bamboo caressed his beard and said leisurely
"You are not allowed to hurt the master."
But it was Zana who stood up and opened her arms to stop Yang Wei.
"You? How to protect him?
The Golden Rat God General couldn't help but sneer. As long as he released a little bit of his spiritual pressure, he could suppress the woman in front of him until she could only crawl on the ground.
However, Zana did not collapse as he thought. Instead, she stood in front of Yang Wei more firmly, never retreating even though she was scarred.
"It's my turn to protect you this time."
How can the spiritual pressure of the late Nascent Soul be competed by the Foundation Establishment? Zana was trembling all over but never looked back.
Even if she was going to die today, she would resist until the last moment. It was the man behind her who made her see hope and know that there is still beauty in this world and how charming the scenery outside is.
So she couldn't retreat. There wasn't much she could do for Yang Wei, but she was willing to use her life to bring an end to this brief encounter that was so exciting for her.
"Okay, since you want to die, then I will grant it to you."
When the Golden Rat God saw that the woman was not afraid of threats, he stopped talking and struck her with a claw to kill her.
"Wait"
Qingmeng was about to stop him, but the God of Withered Bamboo had already taken a step forward and blocked him in front of him, holding the green bamboo in his hand slightly angrily.
"Bang!
The next moment, a majestic impact force knocked Qing Meng away, and blood suddenly flew out.
"Master!
